description: This file defines a Smarty internal plugin class 'Smarty_Internal_Resource_Stream' that implements resource handling through stream sources for Smarty templates. It includes methods for populating source metadata, loading template content from streams, and building unique resource names.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Resource_Stream
classes.description: Implements resource handling as streams, extending 'Smarty_Resource_Recompiled', providing methods to populate resource source data, fetch content from streams, and create unique resource identifiers.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates the source object with metadata from the resource, setting file path, unique ID, content, and timestamp based on resource availability.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Loads the template's source content from a stream into a string by reading the file associated with the resource.

methods.name: buildUniqueResourceName
methods.description: Creates a unique resource name based on the class name and resource identifier to prevent conflicts.
